extracted.name: Baked Breaded Cauliflower
extracted.description: Breaded and baked (or roasted) cauliflower florets make a delicious snack or side dish using this 5-ingredient recipe that is ready in less than 1 hour.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk eggs, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl. Place panko bread crumbs in another bowl.
Dip cauliflower florets in egg mixture, then dredge into bread crumbs to coat; place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until tender and lightly browned, flipping once, about 25 minutes.
